name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation & Onboarding Project Lead | SaaS Configuration, Customer Training & AI-Enabled Delivery
summary: Implementation and onboarding lead who runs customer projects from kickoff to handoff. At Wix I owned scope, budget, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio, carried up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, and held 110% of implementation targets while leading onboarding teams of up to 30. At Accelo I sold and scoped project-management software and built the sequenced implementation plans the delivery team executed. Today at Solenzo I configure client systems and databases, and I build AI tools (LLM API calls, n8n/Make/Zapier automations) into delivery to move projects faster.

experience.title: Implementation & Project Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on customer training.
Configure CRM systems and customer databases in GoHighLevel and HubSpot (segmentation, lifecycle stages, data hygiene), and set up and validate data imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel.
Build and deploy AI tools in production client workflows, calling LLM APIs (OpenAI/Claude) and building n8n, Make, and Zapier automations that cut manual steps out of delivery.
Scope expansion work for existing clients, recommending complementary services aligned to each client's goals.
Document every client timeline, deliverable, and decision in Notion, GoHighLevel, and HubSpot, keeping concurrent projects auditable.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder client accounts, holding delivery quality consistent across implementations.

Analyzed partner utilization metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

bullets: Built internal processes that reduced handoff errors and improved reporting accuracy, managing client workflows and tasks in ClickUp while serving as sales team lead.

Ran weekly training sessions, workshops for new initiatives, and 1:1 coaching, and helped hire and onboard new specialists for a vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.
